bull_bear.body: - Dividend held at ₹11.5/sh (115%) despite lower realization + write-offs — explicit shareholder-commitment signal. ₹9,028 cr dividends over 5 yrs; ₹50,000 cr+ to exchequer. 1:2 bonus in FY24-25. Mkt-cap ₹82,000 cr (20-May), +32% since Apr'25 vs +7% BSE Oil&Gas index. D/E held 0.27:1.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation (PSU dividend)

bull_bear.body:
- Crude price (realization $69, already 5-yr low) — direct EBITDA/PAT lever.
- Natural field decline 10–12%/yr — requires relentless 100-well/yr drilling to net +4% CAGR.
- **Gas-premium accrual delay** — new-well 20% premium stranded until NRL commissioning + CGD saturation + mainland evacuation.
- Execution: NRL 9-MMT commissioning (Mar'27) + Paradip pipeline + DFL (FY28) timelines; 7-day NRL shutdown needed to commission DNPL.
- Offshore exploration risk (first large deep-water campaign; capability gap acknowledged for deep-water field development).
- Policy dependency: Samudra Manthan mechanism un-notified (capex sponsorship terms unknown); APM/excise calibration risk.
- Operational disruption: economic blockade cost ~0.1 MMT oil + ~0.3 BCM gas in FY26.
- Mozambique geopolitical/cost-escalation; Russia-asset geopolitical overhang.
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Confident, granular, growth-forward. CMD repeatedly emphasized "explore more, produce more," running-daily-production-records, and government alignment. Candid on constraints (realization low, premium-accrual delay, blockade loss, un-notified Samudra Manthan terms). Strong willingness to give concrete numbers (capex/well, production targets, timelines). Defensive only on Samudra Manthan fiscal mechanics ("wait for notification").
bull_bear.title: Management tone

bull_bear.body:
- New-well-gas 20% premium is **definitional vs allocation** — even today's 8 MMSCMD contains "new well gas" by definition but earns APM until *allocated*; premium is a future delta, not current.
- NRL has **no excise sunset clause** even at 9 MMTPA — a durable structural margin support most miss.
- Samudra Manthan = government *capex subsidy* for deep/ultra-deep wells (₹3,200 cr stratigraphic corpus + per-well sponsorship), de-risking OIL's offshore capex without changing CPSE fiscal sharing (Cat-2/3 basins: nil revenue share, 7/15-yr deferred royalty).
- TotalEnergies is an *operator* (not service co) — TSA gives genuine technical transfer + potential co-investment, materially de-risking the offshore campaign.
- DNPL chose to stay *captive* (not common-carrier) once DFL authorized; NRL's *reseller* status (PNGRB waiver) is the mechanism to push surplus NE gas to GAIL/mainland.
- Crude write-offs in FY26 PAT — an E&P-specific one-off mgmt flagged while still holding dividend.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious insights

business.body:
- **E&P (standalone):** standalone PAT ₹4,455 cr; topline ₹24,039 cr; realization $69/bbl the binding constraint. RRR 1.20.
- **NRL (downstream, ~69% sub):** best-ever year — 103% capacity utilization, 99.1% operational availability, 87.25% distillate yield (record), record MS 727 TMT, **GRM 1.6x prior year**; conferred **Navratna** (Dec'25). ~₹3,000 cr NE excise benefit (no sunset). Export option (Indo-Bangladesh Friendship Pipeline / HSD) intact but 9-MMT viability NOT dependent on exports (domestic refined demand +7–8%).
- **Pipelines:** product/gas/crude in NE; multiple expansions (see §4).
business.title: Segment performance

business.body:
- ⭐ Domestic gas-evacuation buildout + PNG-over-LPG migration → CGD/city-gas entities in NE & mainland; GAIL (offtake/reseller chain).
- ⭐ NRL 9-MMT + petrochem → polypropylene/petrochem value-chain; NE fuel supply security.
- ✅ Samudra Manthan capex sponsorship → all deep-water E&P (OIL, ONGC) + IOC majors entering India.
- Green-H2 at <$3/kg (NRL BOO ₹279/kg) → refinery decarbonization supply chains.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries

latest_quarter.body:
- Crude realization $69/bbl — lowest in 5 yrs — primary EBITDA headwind; mitigated by production records + royalty/post-wellhead reforms returning more cash to upstream.
- Gas at APM today; 20% new-well premium is the realization upside once allocation/evacuation align.
- Deep-well strategy (avg 4,300 m) sustains ~4% production CAGR against 10–12% natural decline.
- NRL GRM 1.6x prior; mgmt: current refining margin already ~equivalent to excise benefit, so margin cushions any future excise calibration (excise calibrates with HSD FOB).

latest_quarter.title: QoQ log

outlook.body:
- **Oil production target: 4 MMT** — achievable if **100 wells/yr** drilled (60 production + 40 exploration framing; ~52 dev wells already driving daily records). Director-Exploration: ~11,000 TMT exit-rate path → "you are there at 4."
- **Gas: 3.35 BCM guidance for FY27** (year ending Mar'27); **5 BCM target by end-FY28** — needs Duliajan Feeder Line + Duliajan-Numaligarh (DNPL) commissioning. Path: 8 → ~9.5 MMSCMD (FY28) → 13 MMSCMD (FY29); can stretch to 15 MMSCMD with 15–18 new gas/deep wells. Longer-term upstream scale-up **10→12 MMTOE by 2030**.
- **Gas price / new-well premium:** 1.5 MMSCMD allocated as **New Well Gas to NRL** (20% premium over monthly APM). Benefit accrues only *after* NRL commissioning + CGD saturation — **delay in accrual flagged**; base 8 MMSCMD stays at APM. Royalty/post-wellhead-cost reforms also recently moved in upstream's favour (more cash to E&P).
- **Capex:** OIL upstream **~₹10,000 cr/yr rollover** (last yr, this yr, next yr) for ~100 onshore wells + shallow-water. FY26 total OIL capex was **₹13,025 cr** (60% expl/dev drilling, 25% facilities/projects, 13% strategic investments). Shallow-water well ~₹800 cr each; deep-water ~₹1,200 cr each (4+4 wells, ~₹4,800–5,000 cr, Samudra-Manthan-funded). First deep-water well spud ~mid-2027.
- **NRL expansion (3→9 MMTPA):** on track, **full commissioning by Mar'27**, stabilized 9 MMT by Mar'28. Crude-in done 31-Dec-25; CDU/VDU "mother units" + part SRU by end-Jul'26 (~400 TMT mostly diesel), DHDT a month later, PFCC + RPTU by Dec'26/Jan'27. PP unit underway. **Total project capex ~₹40,000 cr (₹46,000 cr incl. ₹7,200 cr polypropylene unit + Paradip-Numaligarh crude pipeline).**
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL)

outlook.body:
- Oil: 3.45 MMT FY26; daily peak 81,354 b/d, currently ~82,200 b/d (running records). 74 wells drilled (22 expl + 52 dev), 307 workovers — all records. Releasable drillable-location inventory jumped to **218** (from ~45), avg well depth Assam shelf 2,300→4,300 m.
- Gas: 3.15 BCM (~8 MMSCMD); 2P gas reserve 121 MMTOE. 11 compressor stations live (+11 procuring) → zero-flare + higher oil. Gas fields cited: Baghjan, Kumchai (Arunachal), Chandmari, Mechaki, Kharsang (JV).
- **Pipelines (midstream):**
  - NSPL product pipe (Numaligarh-Siliguri) 1.72 → **5.5 MMTPA**, mechanically complete Oct'25, PM-inaugurated Mar'26; ₹750 cr vs ₹860 cr approved (₹100 cr saved).
  - DNPL gas pipe (Duliajan-Numaligarh) 1.2 → **2.5 MMSCMD**, mechanically complete Nov'25; commissioning pending a 7-day NRL shutdown; **captive** (DNPL board chose captive once DFL authorized). Incremental ~1.5 MMSCMD eligible for new-well 20% premium.
  - Duliajan Feeder Line (DFL, 175 km) authorized Feb'26 → +3.5 MMSCMD NE-to-mainland evacuation; mechanical completion ~FY28 (+40% gas offtake).
  - NE Gas Grid feeder 390 km; North-Bank extension ~150 km.
  - Crude pipeline doubling 9.65 → 18 MMTPA planned; gas capacity +4x, product +2x.
  - **Paradip-Numaligarh crude import pipeline (9 MMTPA)** — 92% physical / 99% ROU as of 30-Apr-26 (feedstock for expanded refinery).
outlook.title: Production profile / pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Offshore exploration campaign** (biggest ever): ~50% of acreage offshore. Andaman-Nicobar gas occurrence (2nd well) being appraised — proves basin petroliferous; 6,000 m Kerala-Konkan shallow-water deepest-well drilling (at ~3,400 m); KG DSF appraisal. 40,000 sq km deep/ultra-deep across Mahanadi + KG; 4,200 km 2D + 5,300 km 3D seismic done. **TotalEnergies** technology-service-agreement partner (Nov'25) — capability + potential co-investment.
- **NRL 3→9 MMTPA** + polypropylene (petrochem entry).
- **Gas monetization & CGD/CNG/PNG:** 81 CNG → 500; 73,300 PNG → 1.4 mn by 2030–35; NRL notified as **reseller** from DNPL (~50,000 scmd to NE CGD now). AVFCL fertilizer offtake; ~800 tea units convertible to gas.
- **New energy (OIGEL):** ~2 GW RE pipeline (Assam/HP/Rajasthan), target 5+ GW by 2040; 25 CBG plants by 2030 (2 under construction Bhubaneswar/Tinsukia, 3 tendering); 2G bamboo ethanol 49 KTPA (PM-inaugurated 14-Sep-25) yielding green furfural/acetic acid/biochar (export optionality, REACH cert in progress); green hydrogen — NRL 2.4 KTPA by end-FY26 + 10 KTPA BOO at ₹279/kg (<$3), OIL pilots Jorhat + Baddi (HP).
- **Overseas:** Mozambique LNG force-majeure lifted Nov'25, ~6,000 on ground, 2 trains (~6.5–13 MMTPA) commissioning end-2028/early-2029 → equity gas to India; ~$1.8 bn committed (+~$300 mn cost escalation to CCEA). Russia (Taas+Vankor) ~$1 bn dividend recovered (~100%). Libya 95/96 major commercial discovery.
- **Critical minerals:** graphite+vanadium (Arunachal), potash (W. Rajasthan) — exploration leases secured.
outlook.title: Growth / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Integrated Maharatna upstream PSU pivoting from mature-onshore oil to a **production-growth + gas-monetization + offshore-exploration** story: targeting 4 MMT oil / 5 BCM gas via 100-wells/yr drilling and new evacuation pipelines, while NRL's 3→9 MMTPA refinery expansion (commissioning thru Mar'27) adds a large downstream leg. Government tailwinds (Samudra Manthan capex sponsorship, new-well-gas 20% premium, no excise sunset for NRL) underpin the medium-term re-rating; near-term capped by soft crude realization ($69/bbl) and a 10–12% natural field decline.
